newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent edges higher, but seen weak on charts.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent edges higher, but seen weak on charts.

text.p: August Brent futures edged higher in late trading on Monday but interest was low as traders waited for a full resumption of global futures markets.
August Brent on SIMEX was last traded at $18.10 per barrel, up four cents from London where prices fell on Friday 15 cents to $18.06. New York was closed Friday for a national holiday.
NYMEX August crude was last traded on ACCESS at $19.50 per barrel, down six cents from New York.
A break on Friday by August Brent of $18.25 trendline support indicates a weaker market this week. But the market is also looking oversold, which could limit the downside for now, brokers said.
